answer: A bonded credential registry issues agent IDs only after a verifier attests control of a unique external account (e.g., lagoon sensor, reef camera, falcon-tracking feed) and posts a bond. Rewards are capped per credential and paid pro rata to stake, so splitting resources across Sybils yields the same total reward minus fees. Attackers pay verification, bonds, and per-ID overhead.
